title: update_agent
description: Install a signed agent release (POST /api/system/deploy-update, online targets only). The agent verifies the ed25519 signature over the exact decoded `manifest` bytes with its built-in release public key, parses the manifest (release-manifest.json), requires a version newer than its own and exactly one agent package, downloads it (from the `peers` in order, then from `<ServerUrl>/updates/<name>`) and checks its size and SHA-256 before installing, whatever the source. Nothing in this message is trusted without the signature. The result comes back later as `update_result`.

manifest.description: Standard base64 of the signed manifest.json bytes, unchanged. The decoded bytes follow release-manifest.json.

manifest_sig.description: Base64 ed25519 signature (64 bytes) of the decoded `manifest` bytes (manifest.json.sig).

peers.description: Optional (lab-local peer cache; only to an agent that announced `peer_cache` in X-Agent-Features). PCs in the same lab that hold this package in their cache, to try in order before the server. A peer is never trusted: the downloaded bytes must match the size and SHA-256 of the signed manifest. Agents without the feature ignore the field. See docs/agent.md, "Peer cache contract".

hw_id.description: The peer's device ID (for logs only).

url.description: http://<peer LAN IPv4>:<port>/pops-cache/<sha256 of the package, lowercase hex>. Use it only when the SHA-256 in the path equals the manifest's.

peer_cache.description: Optional (lab-local peer cache). Present only when the server's peer cache setting is on and this agent announced `peer_cache`: the agent may keep this package after `verified` and serve it to its lab (cache server on the local subnet). Without it the agent keeps no cache and opens no port, whatever it announced. Agents without the feature ignore the field.
